subject: Proposal: Private release guardrails, timebox & rollback plan (Acme Bank)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmebank.com>, Michael Zhou <michael.zhou@acmebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Private release guardrails, timebox & rollback plan (Acme Bank)

Hi Tara / Michael —

Following our security review, attached is a concise proposal for the upcoming private deployment upgrade to the pinned runtime we discussed. High-level items we want agreement on before we schedule the maintenance window: 

- Version pinning: we will pin Core Runtime v2.8.1 and Model bundle r2027-11-01 for the initial roll. No automatic branch upgrades during the first 30 days post-release.
- Timebox & maintenance window: propose two candidate windows (see attached CSV): Sat 2027-11-13 02:00–04:00 PT or Sun 2027-11-14 03:00–05:00 PT. Expect ~90 minutes of service impact for rolling instances, with blue/green cutoff fallback if needed.
- Canary plan: staged canary across 10% of hosts for 3 hours, monitoring latency, error rate, and auth failures.
- Rollback triggers: >2% request error rate sustained over 15 minutes, or any failed KV cache invalidation causing >5s tail latency on core endpoints.
- Rollback procedure: automated rollback to previous pinned image, followed by manual verification checklist (see rollback-checklist.md).
- Audit & evidence: we will provide binary upgrade logs, k8s event dumps, and pre/post latency slices for your auditors.

Attachments: private-upgrade-guardrails-v1.pdf; maintenance-window-slots.csv; rollback-checklist.md

Please confirm whether the proposed windows fit your blackout periods and whether Acme requires an expanded audit package. If you approve, we'll lock a window and circulate the runbook + on-call roster.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142
From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmebank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Zhou <michael.zhou@acmebank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Private release guardrails, timebox & rollback plan (Acme Bank)

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few constraints from our side: 

- Blackout windows: we can accept maintenance only between 01:00–06:00 PT on weekends. The Sun slot looks fine; Sat would need sign-off from Ops.
- Audit requirement: please include a replayable access log slice and a signed attestation summarizing any schema changes to request metadata. Our security team needs those artifacts for the compliance packet.
- Staging canary: we require a 72-hour canary in our staging environment prior to production cutover. Can you confirm you can support extended canary validation (we will provide a synthetic workload script)?

Also please add a contact for escalation in the first 24h after the upgrade — we need a single pager for audit purposes (name, role, phone).

On the rollback triggers, the thresholds look fine but please add a safety valve: if rollback occurs, do not reattempt the same release for at least 7 days without a postmortem.

Regards,
Tara Singh
VP, Platform Operations
Acme Bank
tara.singh@acmebank.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmebank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Private release guardrails, timebox & rollback plan (Acme Bank)

Tara / Jonas —

We can support the 72-hour staging canary and the extended audit artifacts. A couple operational notes: 

- We propose Sunday 2027-11-14 03:00–05:00 PT as the primary slot (matches your blackout). We'll provision a dedicated on-call rotation: Marissa (primary), Jonas (secondary), Karthik (engineering lead).
- Escalation pager: Jonas Weber (primary) +1 415-555-0142; Karthik Iyer (eng lead) +1 650-555-0210.
- Runbook additions: I attached an internal rollback-checklist.md with exact kubectl/snapshot commands, cluster failover steps, and post-rollback validation queries. Also we will snapshot the KV cache before cutover.
- Post-upgrade verification: 30-minute observation window, then extended 24-hour checks with automated regression alerts (we'll share the alert thresholds).

Tara — can you confirm Acme will run the synthetic workload against our staging canary starting Nov 10 so we can finish checks before the weekend?

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acmebank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Private release guardrails, timebox & rollback plan (Acme Bank)

Tara / Marissa —

Thanks — locking Sunday 2027-11-14 03:00–05:00 PT for the maintenance window. Action items we are completing this week: 

1) Redwood: finalize rollback-checklist.md (attached) and publish runbook to the linked Jira (INF-4321).
2) Redwood: snapshot KV cache and produce pre-upgrade metrics dump.
3) Acme: begin synthetic workload in staging on Nov 10 and confirm signal windows.
4) Security: provide signed attestation + replayable access log slice by Nov 9.

I've scheduled the maintenance invite and added the escalation numbers to the event. DocuSign for the temporary SLA exception (for extended canary) has been sent: https://app.docusign.com/ACME-2211.

If no objections by EOD Friday Nov 5, we consider this approved and will circulate the final runbook.

Best,
Jonas
